1io5w94.description_en:
I am thrilled to inform you that we have a particularly ambitious assignment for you.
[TARGET] has been marked for termination. You may know them already: a particularly high-profile member of the People’s Alliance who is notorious for having thwarted numerous attempts against their life. We initially considered it too troublesome until our client offered an even more outrageous amount of credits to see this to completion.
The target’s last known location was at [LOCATION]. Expect a top-of-the-line ship and a skilled escort.
We look forward to hearing about their untimely demise.
Sincerely,
Vaughn

我很高兴地通知你，我们有一个特别有挑战性的任务交给你。[TARGETNAME] 已经被标记为清除目标。你可能已经认识他们了：人民联盟一个特别高调的成员，以多次挫败谋杀他们的企图而臭名昭著。我们最初觉得这太麻烦了，直到我们客户愿意开价更高的信用点来完成这个任务。

目标最后已知的位置在 [LOCATION]。预计他们会有一艘顶级飞船和一名技术娴熟的护卫陪同。

我们期待听到他们意外死亡的消息。

此致，
沃恩

635uz5.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
635uz5.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏材料而受阻，他们认为这些物资可能对他们的实验至关重要。

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

f9xn0j.description_en:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.
Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION] and likely rearming for another attack.
We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.
Stows out
f9xn0j.description_zh:
多年来，许多想当帮派的人都试图挑战猎头帮，认为他们可以强行进入这个星系。现在我们还在这里，他们都不在了。但似乎这些团体的幸存者决定重新联合起来，再次尝试。看来有些人永远都学不会教训。

最近一群人袭击了我们的物资运输队，法官想要迅速消灭他们，这也不奇怪。我们得知他们位于 [LOCATION] 附近，可能正在重新武装准备再次攻击。

我们希望你去那里，让他们后悔没有和他们的老帮派一起死去。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

1vq3ew5.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
1vq3ew5.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部

One of our high priority clients is under attack from a criminal gang targeting their [OBJECTS] in [LOCATION]. The client’s assets are valuable, so we need to keep those safe at all costs, but I won’t kid – it’ll be a challenge and a half with these thugs determined to do some real damage.

1rlka4t.description_en:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.
We’re not gonna let that happen though.
Snatch that blackbox at [LOCATION] and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.
Apparently, this area is a bit of a hot zone. Probably why they staged the accident there. You should probably bring some backup so you don’t get ghosted before you can bring the blackbox to us at [DESTINATION].
-Bit Zeros
1rlka4t.description_zh:
我就不跟你说这王八蛋对咱们干过啥了，反正关键是这个混蛋想通过飞船坠毁去骗保，保险公司想看黑匣子录像来确认一切是不是“光明正大”的。

我们肯定不能让这事儿发生。

去 [LOCATION] 把黑匣子抢出来，给我们送到这儿来，我们好对录像做点“创意编辑”。

话说这片区域有点危险，估计也是他们选这儿策划事故的原因。你最好带上几个帮手，别还没把黑匣子运到 [DESTINATION] 给咱们就被人整没了。

- 零比特

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has received intelligence that outlaws are planning to launch an attack on a target within the UEE. In an effort to prevent this from happening, we need a contractor to patrol a sector we believe these outlaws are using to prepare for their attack.
Outlaw activity in this sector is higher than normal, so InterSec recommends that you bring backup. When ready, dispatch to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

Got what should be a routine contract for someone looking to cut their teeth on some patrol work.
We're been hired to secure the space around RSI's Discovery Month event. The job is mainly a deterrent against any opportunistic outlaws in the area, but that doesn't mean you should let your guard down. If your scanners pick up anything strange don't hesitate to act.
Once you've accepted, head to the first patrol point. After you've scanned the area, I'll update you on where to head next.
Best of luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

尤金·沃尔顿
